summary: Revision 1 (PR #91, closed without merging) added src/content/blog/beginner/intuition-line-palmistry.md, item 20 (the last Next 25 item) from docs/editorial-backlog.md, bounded by the Director-verified Cheiro/Benham evidence in .ai-ops/evidence/PP-RELAY-050-cheiro-benham-intuition-line.md, but Director review found four bounded source-integrity/correctness defects. Revision 2 (PR #92, closed without merging) corrected those four defects and passed CI plus independent Director revalidation, but Director review found three residual source-boundary defects in otherwise sound prose. Revision 3 preserves every valid revision-2 correction (removed 'line of clairvoyance' outside the FAQ, removed the unsupported 'writing decades apart' chronology, replaced the 'easiest to confuse' superlative with neutral 'A nearby look-alike is' wording, and separated the myths/FAQ historical association from Palmistry Path's own policy statement) and corrects only: (1) Benham's paragraph no longer adds 'situations' or a 'reading ... through impression rather than deliberate analysis' cognitive-mechanism contrast beyond the approved intuitive-impressions/estimating-people association; (2) the same paragraph no longer claims Benham's degree reading is 'a claim about degree that Cheiro doesn't', an unsupported inference from Cheiro's source silence, and now states only that Benham also gives the approved deep-versus-broken degree reading; (3) the psychic-power myth no longer characterizes the historical reading as 'not a claim about paranormal ability', a negative gloss on the authors' intent the evidence does not establish, and keeps their approved sensitive/impressionable association followed by Palmistry Path's separately stated policy; (4) the Mercury-line look-alike myth no longer claims 'mistaking one for the other is an easy error' and now closes with only the approved facts (nearby territory, can run alongside one another per Cheiro, remain distinct, distinguished by Benham's shape test). Updated docs/source-verification-log.md Pass 17 (rewritten as a single self-contained revision-3 record, since revision 2 was never merged and no earlier Pass 17 exists on main), the PP-RELAY-050 changelog entry, and docs/editorial-backlog.md item 20's published notes so none repeats a rejected claim as approved prose or asserts that an earlier revision passed final Director source review. Reciprocal link in m-line-palmistry.md and docs/editorial-backlog.md count/status bookkeeping (71 -> 72) are unchanged from revision 2.
